hook: Stop paying list price for robot vacuums
hook_vo: Stop paying list price for robot vacuums. The Roborock Q7 M5 Plus is a lesson in why.
product_vo: It vacuums, mops, and empties itself into a dock bag that lasts up to nine weeks.

feature_vo.1: The dock swallows seven to nine weeks of dirt before you ever touch a bag.
feature_vo.2: Ten thousand pascals of suction handles hard floors and pet hair with ease.
feature_vo.3: LiDAR mapping with no-go zones, and none of it needs a subscription.

feature_detail.1: 2.7L bag in the base. Hands-free for weeks, not days.
feature_detail.2: Strong on hard floors and low-pile rugs. Okay on thick carpet.
feature_detail.3: Accurate multi-floor maps, room-by-room cleaning, free app.

price_vo: It launched at three fifty nine, but the street price tells the real story. Right now it is two forty nine ninety nine, below the ninety day average. That's a good price.
cta_vo: Full review and live price history at gadget drop dot tech. Link in the description.

1.sub: Strong on hard floors and low-pile rugs. Fine on thin carpet.
